supplements.title: Fatty Acid Metabolism in Health and Cancer: From Fundamental Mechanisms to Therapeutic Application.
supplements.summary: Disrupted fatty acid metabolism drives cancer growth; targeting this process through drugs, gene therapy, and diet offers new treatment opportunities.

supplements.title: Chk1-Targeted Hesperidin Liposomes for Breast Cancer Therapy: An Integrated In Silico, In Vitro, and In Vivo Evaluation.
supplements.summary: Hesperidin-loaded liposomes targeting Chk1 protein effectively killed breast cancer cells and reduced tumors in animal models.

supplements.title: Ungeremine suppresses colon cancer cell proliferation through inhibition of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Ungeremine kills colon cancer cells by blocking a key growth pathway and triggering cell death through oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Molecular insights into induction of apoptosis and regulation of cell cycle proliferation by cycloartane triterpenoids from Dysoxylum malabaricum in breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Natural compounds from Dysoxylum malabaricum kill breast cancer cells by triggering mitochondrial dysfunction and programmed cell death.

supplements.title: Microbial reprogramming of immunogenic cell death: a new paradigm in tumor immunotherapy.
supplements.summary: Gut microbes can trigger immune-boosting tumor cell death, offering a new personalized cancer treatment approach with fewer side effects.

supplements.title: Integrating morphological and phytochemical studies on some selected taxa of Lamiaceae Lindl. and Verbenaceae Juss.
supplements.summary: Essential oils from Lamiaceae and Verbenaceae plants showed anti-cancer activity against hepatocellular carcinoma cells in laboratory testing.

supplements.title: Odoribacter laneus protects intestinal barrier by bile acid-FXR axis in acute pancreatitis.
supplements.summary: A probiotic bacterium protects the intestinal barrier in acute pancreatitis by restoring healthy gut bacteria and bile acid metabolism.

supplements.title: Dihydroartemisinin alleviates dextran sulfate sodium-induced colitis in mice: Associations with gut microbiota, arachidonic acid metabolism, and the IL-17 signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Dihydroartemisinin reduces colon inflammation in mice by modifying gut bacteria and immune responses, suggesting potential for ulcerative colitis treatment.

supplements.title: Paris polyphylla saponin Ⅱ induces autophagy-associated ferroptosis by regulating the BECLIN1/SLC7A11 axis in cervical cancer.
supplements.summary: A plant compound called Paris polyphylla saponin II kills cervical cancer cells by triggering a dual death mechanism and shows promise as a safer alternative to current drugs.

supplements.title: Elucidation of the anti-inflammatory mechanism of isoliquiritigenin from Glycyrrhiza uralensis using activity-based protein profiling
supplements.summary: Isoliquiritigenin from licorice root reduces inflammation by blocking an enzyme that produces inflammatory molecules.

supplements.title: A literature scanning and prioritization framework to guide future systematic reviews for World Cancer Research Fund International's Global Cancer Update Programme
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a framework to prioritize future systematic reviews on diet, exercise, and weight's effects on 19 cancer types.

supplements.title: Elephantopus scaber L.: phytochemistry, pharmacology, nanoformulation, and synthetic modification - a review.
supplements.summary: Elephantopus scaber, an Asian medicinal plant, contains compounds that kill cancer cells and reduce inflammation through multiple cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Inhibitory effects of mycosubtilin on proliferation of colon cancer SW480 cells.
supplements.summary: Mycosubtilin, a natural compound, outperformed standard chemotherapy in stopping colon cancer cell growth by triggering apoptosis.

supplements.title: PFAS is associated with perineural invasion in triple-negative breast cancer with a potential role for Cathepsin D dysregulation: a multi-omics and experimental study.
supplements.summary: PFAS pollutants may promote nerve invasion in triple-negative breast cancer through Cathepsin D dysregulation, with a natural compound showing promise as treatment.

supplements.title: The impact of exercise interventions before, during, and following neoadjuvant therapies for locally advanced rectal cancer: a critical review.
supplements.summary: Exercise during cancer treatment for rectal cancer may reduce side effects and improve quality of life, but more research is needed.

off_label.title: In vitro screening of compounds for targeting gastric cancer with Y220C p53 mutation: a molecule combining zinc chelation and a Michael acceptor drives CDKN1 and BBC3 expression to restore a p53-dependent cytotoxicity.
off_label.summary: A new compound called AG3 reactivates mutated p53 in gastric cancer cells, restoring cancer-killing ability while protecting healthy cells.

off_label.title: Interleukin-34 induced Arg1+ macrophages play a key role in breast cancer brain metastasis.
off_label.summary: Breast cancer cells use interleukin-34 to recruit immune cells that promote brain metastasis, and blocking this pathway shrinks tumors in mice.

off_label.title: Comprehensive quantum chemical analysis, vibrational spectroscopy, molecular docking, ADMET, and in vitro validation studies of hydroxychloroquine-MRGPRX2 complex in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Hydroxychloroquine shows strong binding to a mast cell receptor and reduces glioblastoma cell viability, suggesting potential as a new glioblastoma treatment.

off_label.title: RET signaling as a mediator of estrogen receptor positive breast cancer brain metastasis.
off_label.summary: RET protein drives brain metastasis in estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer and can be blocked by the drug Pralsetinib.

off_label.title: Cross-Species Transcriptomic and Network Analysis of Human and Canine Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma Identifies a Conserved Replication-DNA Damage Module for Drug Repurposing.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified shared DNA damage genes in human and canine lymphoma, suggesting existing drugs like PARP inhibitors could treat dogs with this cancer.

off_label.title: The insulin receptor inhibitor BMS-754807 alleviates neuroinflammation and Alzheimer's disease pathologies across human cellular and mouse models.
off_label.summary: BMS-754807, a drug tested for breast cancer, reduces brain inflammation and Alzheimer's disease symptoms in laboratory and mouse studies.

off_label.title: Anticancer activity of fluoxetine Janus dendrimer against cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Fluoxetine combined with Janus dendrimers shows strong anticancer activity against breast cancer cells in laboratory tests.

off_label.title: Simvastatin reprograms lipid metabolism in B16.F10 melanoma cells to favor an early resistant phenotype.
off_label.summary: Simvastatin alters melanoma cell metabolism, but initially triggers survival mechanisms that could lead to drug resistance.

off_label.title: Macrophage ALDH2 drives immunotherapy resistance by silencing CXCL9 through metabolic-epigenetic crosstalk.
off_label.summary: Blocking ALDH2 in immune cells reprograms tumors to respond better to immunotherapy by reactivating anti-tumor immune responses.

off_label.title: Inhibition of the oncogenic GTPase dynamin-related protein 1 (DRP1) by the FDA-approved drug fosaprepitant: In silico, biophysical, and in vitro characterization of its anti-myeloma activity.
off_label.summary: FDA-approved antiemetic fosaprepitant inhibits DRP1 protein, disrupts mitochondria, and kills multiple myeloma cells.

off_label.title: AI-genomics synergy for drug repurposing in breast cancer: an interpretability-driven framework.
off_label.summary: AI tools help identify existing drugs that could treat different breast cancer types by analyzing genetic data and making predictions transparent for clinical use.

off_label.title: Pharmacokinetics of Dexamethasone in Tuberculous Meningitis.
off_label.summary: Rifampicin reduces dexamethasone levels in tuberculosis meningitis patients, potentially decreasing the steroid's effectiveness when used together.

off_label.title: Drug screening of sarcoma cells: finding shared sensitivities.
off_label.summary: Researchers screened 1,387 drugs across sarcoma cells, identifying microtubule and aurora kinase inhibitors as most effective, with subtype-specific sensitivities revealing shared vulnerabilities.

off_label.title: Metformin Reverses Progesterone Resistance in Endometrial Cancer by Targeting the AMPK-FOXO1-CALB2 Pathway.
off_label.summary: Metformin combined with progesterone overcomes treatment resistance in endometrial cancer by activating a specific cellular pathway.

off_label.title: Conserved hydrophobic gatekeeper mechanisms in COX-1-like pockets revealed by AI-driven pocket similarity and molecular dynamics simulations of mofezolac.
off_label.summary: AI analysis reveals mofezolac, a COX-1 inhibitor, may work against multiple proteins through conserved binding pockets, suggesting potential for ovarian cancer treatment.

biomarkers.title: Amplification of pro-proliferative genes adjacent to the F3 gene in pancreatic adenocarcinoma is associated with worse outcomes.
biomarkers.summary: Gene amplification near F3 in pancreatic cancer is linked to worse survival and increased blood clot risk.

biomarkers.title: In vitro screening of compounds for targeting gastric cancer with Y220C p53 mutation: a molecule combining zinc chelation and a Michael acceptor drives CDKN1 and BBC3 expression to restore a p53-dependent cytotoxicity.
biomarkers.summary: A new compound called AG3 reactivates mutated p53 in gastric cancer cells, restoring cancer-killing ability while protecting healthy cells.

biomarkers.title: Tebentafusp (IMCgp100), a first in class immune-mobilizing monoclonal T-cell receptors against cancer (ImmTAC) for HLA-A*02:01 positive uveal melanoma: Product review.
biomarkers.summary: Tebentafusp, a new immunotherapy, significantly improved survival in patients with advanced uveal melanoma by activating immune cells to kill cancer.

biomarkers.title: T-cell mechanobiology: How molecular forces shape immune function.
biomarkers.summary: Physical forces in the immune environment shape T-cell function, suggesting that incorporating mechanics into cancer immunotherapies could improve treatment effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Lung Cancer Screening and Prevention: Beyond Conventional Strategies in a Rapidly Changing Global Milieu.
biomarkers.summary: Comprehensive lung cancer screening using AI and blood tests can detect cancer earlier in never-smokers, especially in East Asia.

biomarkers.title: Decoding TCR specificity and T cell fate at the immunological synapse.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a method to identify immune-suppressing T cells in tumors that can be reactivated using existing immunotherapy drugs.

biomarkers.title: Regulation of Immune Checkpoints: From Molecular Mechanisms to Clinical Therapies.
biomarkers.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors block tumor escape pathways, but resistance and side effects limit effectiveness; combination strategies and biomarkers offer solutions.

biomarkers.title: Fatty Acid Metabolism in Health and Cancer: From Fundamental Mechanisms to Therapeutic Application.
biomarkers.summary: Disrupted fatty acid metabolism drives cancer growth; targeting this process through drugs, gene therapy, and diet offers new treatment opportunities.

biomarkers.title: Light-controlled disruption of cancer cell dormancy via photoswitchable stress hormone receptor degraders.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed light-controlled drugs that degrade a stress hormone receptor to wake dormant lung cancer cells, reducing relapse risk.

biomarkers.title: Autism-like phenotypes and increased NMDAR2D expression in mice with KDM5B histone lysine demethylase deficiency.
biomarkers.summary: KDM5B gene loss causes autism-like behaviors in mice by increasing a brain receptor; blocking this receptor with memantine restores communication.

biomarkers.title: Micro(nano)plastics in the Development of Myocardial Fibrosis: From Clinical Detection to Molecular Mechanism.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that tiny plastic particles accumulate in heart tissue and may contribute to dangerous heart scarring in patients.

biomarkers.title: Advancements in therapeutic HBV vaccines: navigating the path toward functional cure.
biomarkers.summary: Therapeutic HBV vaccines combined with antivirals and immunomodulators show promise for achieving functional cure in chronic hepatitis B patients.

biomarkers.title: Highly sensitive analysis of N-glycans via derivatization with quinoline hydrazide reagents.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed chemical reagents that improve detection of abnormal blood sugar molecules, enabling better disease diagnosis through advanced testing methods.

biomarkers.title: Tracer-assisted shotgun lipidomics (TASL): A quantitative workflow integrating stable-isotope tracing with global lipidome profiling.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed TASL, a new method combining isotope tracing with lipid profiling to simultaneously track lipid production and measure total lipid levels in cells.

biomarkers.title: Label-free and isothermal multiplex detection of miRNAs using self-priming hairpin probes and light-up aptamer transcription.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a simple, rapid method to simultaneously detect multiple cancer-related microRNAs using hairpin probes and glowing aptamers.

trials.title: Tebentafusp (IMCgp100), a first in class immune-mobilizing monoclonal T-cell receptors against cancer (ImmTAC) for HLA-A*02:01 positive uveal melanoma: Product review.
trials.summary: Tebentafusp, a new immunotherapy, significantly improved survival in patients with advanced uveal melanoma by activating immune cells to kill cancer.

trials.title: Lung Cancer Screening and Prevention: Beyond Conventional Strategies in a Rapidly Changing Global Milieu.
trials.summary: Comprehensive lung cancer screening using AI and blood tests can detect cancer earlier in never-smokers, especially in East Asia.

trials.title: Regulation of Immune Checkpoints: From Molecular Mechanisms to Clinical Therapies.
trials.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors block tumor escape pathways, but resistance and side effects limit effectiveness; combination strategies and biomarkers offer solutions.

trials.title: Advancements in therapeutic HBV vaccines: navigating the path toward functional cure.
trials.summary: Therapeutic HBV vaccines combined with antivirals and immunomodulators show promise for achieving functional cure in chronic hepatitis B patients.

trials.title: MyLungHealth, a Patient-Facing Education Tool for Lung Cancer Screening: Qualitative User-Centered Design Study.
trials.summary: Researchers developed MyLungHealth, an educational tool designed to improve patient understanding and participation in lung cancer screening.

trials.title: Large Language Models in Colorectal Cancer Care and Clinical Decision Support: Systematic Review.
trials.summary: Large language models show promise for improving colorectal cancer care by processing clinical data and supporting treatment decisions.

trials.title: Enhancing Immunotherapeutic Response in Colorectal Cancer with a Neuropilin-1-Targeting Tumor-Penetrating Peptide.
trials.summary: A tumor-penetrating peptide targeting neuropilin-1 enhances immunotherapy effectiveness in colorectal cancer by improving immune cell infiltration.

trials.title: Peripheral Measurable Residual Disease Activity Assessment by MALDI-TOF Mass Spectrometry in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Multiple Myeloma in the Phase III GMMG-HD7 Trial.
trials.summary: Mass spectrometry blood tests reliably detect residual multiple myeloma and predict which patients will relapse, improving treatment monitoring.

trials.title: Intrapericardially injected hydrogel loaded with stromal cell secretome microparticles improves post-infarction myocardial repair in pigs.
trials.summary: A hydrogel containing cell secretome microparticles, injected around the heart, improved heart repair after heart attack in pigs.

trials.title: A cDC1-NK/T-Malignant Cell Circuit Drives Immunogenic Remodeling Under PD-1 Blockade in Gastric Cancer.
trials.summary: Chemotherapy plus PD-1 blockade activates immune cells in gastric cancer by strengthening communication between cancer-fighting NK/T cells and dendritic cells.

trials.title: Neutrophil-Macrophage Interactions Shape Inflammatory Macrophage Remodeling in Gastric Cancer During Chemo-Immunotherapy.
trials.summary: Neutrophils communicate with macrophages to boost immune responses in gastric cancer treated with chemotherapy plus immunotherapy.

trials.title: Disparities in prostate cancer screening practices among general practitioners and urologists (PROSHADE study): A cross-sectional study.
trials.summary: Spanish GPs and urologists differ in how they apply shared decision-making and PSA testing for prostate cancer screening.

trials.title: Effectiveness of Microanatomy-based Low-dose Radiosurgery of Vestibular Schwannomas for Hearing Preservation in Patients with Neurofibromatosis Type 2: A Retrospective Analysis of 16 Cases.
trials.summary: Low-dose radiosurgery using detailed tumor anatomy successfully preserved hearing in vestibular schwannoma patients with neurofibromatosis type 2.

trials.title: Engineered GelMA Microgels for Locoregional Doxorubicin Release and Apoptosis Induction in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
trials.summary: Engineered microgels deliver doxorubicin directly to oral cancer tumors, reducing systemic toxicity while effectively triggering cancer cell death.

trials.title: Prognostic impact of FLT3-ITD microclones in young adults with acute myeloid leukemia treated with intensive chemotherapy.
trials.summary: Small FLT3-ITD mutations in acute myeloid leukemia significantly increase relapse risk and should be monitored using advanced genetic testing.
